steps.name: Given user is logged into Merchant Studio Overview
And My Institute status should be displayed
And Accreditation status should be displayed
And logged-in institute should match expected institute
And Create Course button should be displayed
And Add Batch button should be displayed
And Create Course button should navigate to Course Studio page
And user clicks Create New Course Program
And user fills mandatory course details
And user clicks Add Module
And user fills mandatory module details
Then an additional module section should be displayed
When user submits the course
Then the created course status should be displayed
When user returns to Overview page
And Add Batch button should navigate to Batches Attendance page
And user clicks Create Cohort Batch
And user fills mandatory batch details
And user generates batch sessions
Then cohort sessions should be generated
Then the created batch should be displayed in the batch table
